observations: PlayStation 5 Slim console with an integrated disc drive, wrapped in clear plastic film.
Five PS5 game cases: Battlefield 2042, Grand Theft Auto V, Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate, God of War Ragnarok, and FC 25.
The console features the horizontal slit across the side panels characteristic of the Slim model.
An Airtel-branded internet router is visible on the shelf below the console.
All photos are watermarked with 'POSTED ON JAYCYPHER GAMES'.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrapping is a common presentation for 'UK used' imports in Nigeria, but the actual origin cannot be verified through photos.
photo 0 and photo 1 show the slim chassis design with the middle dividing line and disc drive bulge.

claims.claim: going with fc25, gta5, battlefield and morta Kombat 11 ultimate and Ragnarok
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the physical cases for all five listed games.

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware issues or fail to power on.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and running a game disc.

risks.risk: The game cases may be empty or contain scratched/unreadable discs.
risks.proof: Photos of the data side of all five game discs.

risks.risk: The controller may suffer from stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu or in a test application.

risks.risk: The console could be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN) services.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully connecting to the PSN store.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and displaying the dashboard on a TV.
Photos of the five game discs outside their cases.
Photo of the console's rear ports and model number sticker.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a PlayStation 5 Slim Disc Edition with a bundle of games. It can be priced at its worst-case (non-functional) value until proof of operation is provided.
